systems_found: University of California (10 campuses, UCOP, ASUCLA, ANR, UC Law SF)
California State University (23 campuses + Chancellor's Office)
California Community Colleges (73 districts, 116 colleges; locally governed)

sources.institution: UC Annual Wage database (UC Office of the President)
sources.download_url: https://ucannualwage.ucop.edu/wage/search (undocumented AJAX endpoint used by the search form; params op, page, rows, sidx, sord + form fields year, firstname, lastname, location, title, pay range)
sources.institutions_covered: All UC locations: Berkeley, Davis, Irvine, UCLA, Merced, Riverside, San Diego, San Francisco, Santa Barbara, Santa Cruz, UCOP, ASUCLA, ANR, UC Law SF
sources.employees: all (names redacted as '******' for student-status employees, including medical residents)
sources.update_frequency: annual (calendar year data released mid-following year)
sources.size: about 300,000-360,000 rows per year (per Transparent California counts for UC)
sources.blocker: Search-only form with no bulk export; getting everything means paging the undocumented /wage/search endpoint (a form submission, which I did not try)
sources.notes: Official person-level UC source with names and a pay breakdown. The JS (wg.js) shows paged queries with a 'rows' page-size parameter and location 'ALL'. If the owner allows automated form paging, this could be upgraded to B or A. Page also warned 'A search error occurred' at times.

sources.system: UC, CSU, community college districts (plus cities, counties, etc.)
sources.download_url: In-page 'Download CSV' buttons (JS, via https://transparentcalifornia.com/api/v1); filenames like university-of-california-salary-2025.csv. The legacy /export/<year>-<slug>.csv URLs now redirect to the home page.
sources.coverage_years: UC 2011-2025; CSU and community college districts multi-year (about 2011-2025, varies by agency)
sources.institutions_covered: UC (system-wide file), CSU, and most community college districts as separate agencies
sources.format: CSV (after login); HTML tables rendered client-side
sources.terms: not stated on salary page (Privacy and Disclaimer pages linked); robots.txt allows agency pages, disallows /salaries/all/ and /salaries/search/, crawl-delay 1
sources.blocker: The redesigned site requires a (free) account login before any CSV download; the JS sends anonymous users to /login
sources.notes: This would be the best California source (A quality: per-agency, per-year CSVs with names and a full pay breakdown) if the owner creates a free account. It covers CSU and community colleges with names, which official sources do not. Data come from CPRA requests.

sources.institution: Government Compensation in California (State Controller's Office)
sources.system: CSU (mandatory), UC and community college districts (voluntary)
sources.download_url: https://gcc.sco.ca.gov/Reports/RawExport.aspx ; files like https://gcc.sco.ca.gov/RawExport/2024_CaliforniaStateUniversity.zip and 2024_UniversityOfCalifornia.zip (pattern inferred; HEAD returned 403 Cloudflare challenge)
sources.coverage_years: 2009-2025 (2025 CSU data released; 113,967 CSU employees in 2025)
sources.institutions_covered: CSU 23 campuses + Chancellor's Office; UC; reporting community college districts
sources.employees: all positions, but NO employee names
sources.format: CSV in ZIP (raw export by year and employer type)
sources.terms: not stated (SCO posts data as reported and does not audit it)
sources.blocker: Not person-level (positions only, no names), and Cloudflare 'Just a moment' JS challenge returns 403 to scripted requests
sources.notes: Clean official bulk data, and the only official CSU pay source, but it has no names. The field list is from my own knowledge of the GCC raw export because I could not load the page. A human in a browser can probably download the ZIPs.

sources.institution: Sacramento Bee State Worker Pay database
sources.blocker: Search-only news database, sacbee.com refused automated fetch, and it may be paywalled
sources.notes: Fields are from secondary descriptions. CSU person-level data is also available from Transparent California.

private_extra: None found. Stanford, USC, Caltech and other privates publish only IRS 990 data. (Stanford posts some aggregate compensation reports but nothing person-level.)
gaps: No official bulk, person-level file exists for any California higher-ed system. UC names are behind a search form, and CSU and community college names come only from third parties: Transparent California (now behind a free login) and the Sacramento Bee (search-only). The official SCO bulk file has no names and is behind Cloudflare. I did not check individual community college district websites; they post salary schedules, not person-level pay.
notes: I followed the rules strictly: login, form and JS-challenge sources are rated C even when the data underneath are A quality. Recommendation: (1) a free Transparent California account gives A-quality CSVs for UC, CSU and community colleges; (2) if form paging is allowed, the UC Annual Wage /wage/search endpoint gives official UC data from 2010 on. data.ca.gov (CKAN) had no relevant salary datasets. GCC field names are from prior knowledge, not confirmed this session.
